thread:
Maya: thinking about the console UX for routing buckets + quota breakdowns — specifically how we show which auth paths (org key vs project key vs sa) got routed to which capacity tier. current dashboard is kinda opaque :confused:
Ryan: agreed. customers ask why requests moved to fallback model and get billed differently. need clearer attribution per request. :eyes:
Deva: small ask — can we add a per-route 'auth-path' dimension to the request telemetry before we change routing? will help correlate routing policy flips to quota consumption.
Maya: yep. goal: a single tile in Console that shows rate and cost by (auth-path, model-variant, region). minimal first pass.
Sarah: implementation note: we already tag requests with origin headers, but derived auth path (e.g. "org->project->sa") is computed in the auth resolver and isn't emitted downstream. we'll need to propagate a short enum in the request envelope.
Katie: does that mean changing our public API surface? we should keep it internal-only header like `x-rwd-auth-path` so customers don't rely on it.
Deva: +1. internal header, snake_case or kebab? `x-rwd-auth-path` is fine. also include `x-rwd-auth-id` (hashed) for debugging.
Maya: example payload idea (console side):
```json
{
  "auth_path": "org:1234>project:5678>sa:alice@svc",
  "auth_tag": "org_project_sa",
  "auth_hash": "sha256:abcd..."
}
```
Ryan: for rollout: emit only at DEBUG sampling initially (0.1%) to validate cardinality. then raise to 1%/10% before full rollout. we can't blow up cardinality in metrics.
Sarah: agree on sampling. also need an explainer in Console for support agents — show the decision tree that produced the chosen auth path (token exchange vs header vs fallback). short text and a link to the trace.
Katie: UX question — where does the tile live? Per-route page or global billing dashboard? I vote per-route, with a global rollup.
Maya: per-route primary, plus a global view with filters. filter by auth_path, model, region, timeframe.
Deva: will need a helper metric that attributes tokens to billing buckets when fallback occurred. current billing signal only sees final model id, not the auth origin. tricky.
Ryan: propose we emit a paired metric `billing.auth_path.tokens` (count tokens) with labels (auth_path, model_variant, region). sampled until verified.
Sarah: ops concern — make sure this doesn't change SLOs. add the header at the auth proxy so it's cheap, don't add extra RPCs in the hot path.
Maya: ops-bot flagged a potential rollout collision with canary flag `auth_path_tagging` on tomorrow's deploy. deploy-bot: "deploy queued: auth-proxy v2 -> canary 10%"
Katie: ok timeline: debug sampling tomorrow, 10% canary next week, 100% after monitor pass. who owns the console tile?
Deva: I'll own backend metrics + schema. Maya will do Console tile layout. Sarah will check perf and infra constraints. Ryan will define monitoring alerts (cardinality, token attribution spikes, billing delta).
Maya: items to track for unblock: list of top auth_path values (cap to top 100), metric naming convention, retention policy (30d hot), and an FAQ snippet for support.
Ryan: alerting thresholds: if billing.auth_path.tokens(top) changes >20% vs baseline for 5m, page eng-platform-signal. also if unique auth_path cardinality grows >200% in 1h.
Sarah: I'll add a lightweight playbook entry: if spike happens, flip `auth_path_tagging` to sampling 0 and roll back.
Katie: small nit — ensure the header doesn't leak PII. hash service account emails and avoid raw org/project ids in high-cardinality labels. use stable short ids.
Deva: agreed. we'll emit `auth_bucket` labels like `org_1234|proj_5678|sa_h1` (hashed suffix). full resolution only in traces not metrics.
Maya: final question: do we include this in the public changelog? probably mention 'improved internal routing telemetry' without exposing header details.
Ryan: yes, public changelog high-level only. internal docs will have the details.
Maya: cool. action items summarized: Deva + Sarah + Maya to land header and sampled metrics, Ryan to add alerts, Maya to wire console tile mock, Katie to draft internal note. Back in 48h for a quick sync. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: "canary deploy started: auth-proxy v2 -> 10%"
Maya: thanks all.
